manual.detail: PR upgrade-impact checks compare the tested merge with its first parent instead of the possibly stale PR event base. A valid PR is no longer rejected for unrelated merged note edits or missing historical notes. Queue checks retain the full group base, fresh-note requirements and adoption boundary remain, and publication still requires complete interval coverage. Affected PRs need a new check run using the corrected workflow; existing user installations need no repair.
